end.geocode_source: Nominatim query 'Zhenlong Town, Pingnan County, Guangxi, China' (OSM node 3505204982, town-level); the route source additionally names Zhuangzhai Village (庄寨村) within this town as the exact distribution-station site, but that village did not resolve in Nominatim

corridor_notes: GEM row = Pingnan Branch (广西天然气支线管网项目平南天然气支线管道工程), operator Guangxi Gas Group, GEM Status=cancelled/CancelledYear=2024 (pilot pass found this contradicted by the row's own cited ref, which actually reads as a 2020 approval-extension, not a cancellation notice -- separate status_review finding, out of scope here). gigeps.com (verified; a project-information portal republishing the EIA route description) gives a precise route: starts at Guiping distribution station in Mengwei/Mengxu Town (蒙圩镇), Guiping City; runs ~5.7km east crossing the Xiajiang River to valve station #17; ~9.6km further east (parallel to the existing West-2nd-Line Nanning branch) crossing the Yujiang River to the Shesbu valve station; ~14.2km further crossing the Guiwa Expressway and Nanguang high-speed rail; ~8km northeast to the Shespo valve station; then enters Pingnan County through Mule Township and terminates at Pingnan Distribution Station in Zhuangzhai Village (庄寨村), Zhenlong Town (镇隆镇). Total ~58km per this source (55.3km Guiping + 2.7km Pingnan) vs. GEM's 63.00km -- broadly consistent (treated as a rounding/methodology difference, not a contradiction).
researcher_notes: Endpoint place names (Mengwei/Mengxu Town start; Zhuangzhai Village/Zhenlong Town end) are the most precise found -- village-level for the end point per the source prose -- but Nominatim could not resolve either specific village, so town-level centroids stand in as the plotted coordinates. A human router could refine geometry further using the valve-station chain (17# valve station, Shesbu valve station, Shespo valve station, Mule Township) described in corridor_notes if finer intermediate waypoints are wanted. Two spellings appear for the start town across sources ('蒙圩镇' in government-filing titles vs. 'Mengwei' in the gigeps.com English-rendered summary) -- same place, 蒙圩镇/Mengxu Town, Guiping.
